classification.method: fixed host: every load is a new process (cold); no restore exists; warm = the same process's later requests

conclusion: FIXED HOST, NOT LAMBDA. 0xd40 local-file: load -2.064 s (6/6), peak RSS -504 MB; memfd -2.041 s, -504 MB; warm/forward no change; answers bit-identical (60/60, 12/12). x86_64: peak RSS -576 MB (6/6, outside the 1% floor); timings no change inside the co-tenanted host's range; answers identical to x86 P1. Dormant: no change on both arches. No path degrades, but the switch aborts any request for logits, so it is only valid for engines that never ask for them (decshim). Verdict: general opt-in, default ON inside decshim-only deployments; not a llama.cpp-wide default.

One fresh container per load; arms interleaved in reversal-paired random orders (run_ladder.schedule: each arm before its control in exactly half the rounds); page cache primed before round 0; comparisons pair rounds (arm minus p1 in the same round).
